entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, hurry up. This is absolutely ridiculous. I want to talk to someone NOW.
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. I can certainly help you today. How can I assist?
Finally! I ordered this expensive VeloFit jersey and it's completely the wrong size! It's way too tight, I can barely breathe in it. This is unacceptable! I want to send it back immediately.

I'm very sorry to hear the fit isn't right. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the jersey, or is it a preference issue with the sizing?

What kind of stupid question is that? It's too tight! I told you, it's the wrong size! Your sizing charts are a complete lie. Just process the return or get me your manager right now. I'm one click away from leaving a review that will tear you apart.

I understand your frustration, and there's absolutely no need for a manager, I can handle this for you directly. We can definitely get this sorted out. Our jerseys have a 90-day return policy, so you're well within the timeframe for a return or an exchange.
Oh. Well... it should be that easy. Fine. So what do I do?
I can either process a full refund for you, or I can set up an exchange for a different size. Which would you prefer?
I want an exchange. Send me the next size up. And make sure it's right this time.

Of course. I am processing that exchange for you now. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on your account. Just use that to send back the jersey that was too tight, and as soon as the carrier scans it, we'll ship out the new one for you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
